Item.Name: S_TEST_ID
Item.Hint: Enter test ID for reagent preparation or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
select test_desc into :s_test_desc from valid_tests where
test_id=:s_test_id and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 NEXT_ITEM;
 exception when no_data_found then

Item.Name: S_REAGENT_ID
Item.Hint: Enter NEW to prepare new reagent, or use [LISTVAL] to modify existing reagent.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 REC_CNT_rsm number(10);
 REC_CNT_urm number(10);
begin
 nullchk;
 :GLOBAL.test_id := :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id;
 :GLOBAL.reagent_id := :ctrl_blk_1.s_reagent_id; 
 CLEAR_FORM(no_validate);
 execute_trigger('SBC_BANNER'); 
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id := :GLOBAL.test_id ;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_reagent_id := :GLOBAL.reagent_id;
 erase('GLOBAL.test_id');
 erase('GLOBAL.reagent_id');


 if :s_reagent_id = 'NEW' then
 IF :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code = '99' THEN
 show_error('2304' );
 END IF;
 go_item('usable_reagents.reagent_type');
 clear_block(no_acknowledge); 
 set_block_property('usable_reagent_mix',update_allowed,property_true); 
 set_block_property('usable_reagent_mix',insert_allowed,property_true);
 else
 begin
 select count(*) into REC_CNT_rsm 
 from reagent_store_mst 
 where reagent_id = :s_reagent_id 
 and test_id = :s_test_id 
 and ( :global.user_testing_lab_code = '99' 
 or lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code) 
 and remaining_tests > 0
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and reagent_status in ('R','S')
 and reagent_code in (SELECT reagent_code FROM valid_reagents
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id 
 AND preparation_flag in ('P','I')
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate));
 select count(*) into REC_CNT_urm 
 from usable_reagent_mix 
 where prep_reagent_id = :s_reagent_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 if REC_CNT_rsm = '0' or REC_CNT_urm = '0' 
 then
 show_error('1040');
 else
 go_block('usable_reagents');
 execute_query; 
 go_block('usable_reagent_mix');
 execute_query;
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_reagent_id');
 if :global.user_testing_lab_code != '99' then
 show_error('2304');
 set_block_property('usable_reagents',update_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('usable_reagent_mix',update_allowed,property_false);
 else 
 set_item_property('usable_reagents.reagent_type', navigable, property_false);
 set_item_property('usable_reagents.reagent_code', navigable, property_false);
 set_item_property('usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id', navigable, property_false);
 end if;
 end if;
 go_block('usable_reagents');
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1040');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :usable_reagents.reagent_id is null 
 then
 select 'P'||to_char(reagent_seq.nextval)
 into :usable_reagents.reagent_id from dual;
 :usable_reagents.chapter_id:=:global.chapter_id;
 :usable_reagents.reagent_status:='S';
 :lab_code := :global.user_testing_lab_code;
 end if;
 :usable_reagents.visual_qc_flag := 'Y';
 :usable_reagents.remaining_tests := :usable_reagents.no_of_tests;
 :usable_reagents.lot_number := 'Prepared';
 :usable_reagents.received_date := trunc(sysdate);
 :usable_reagents.remaining_tests := :usable_reagents.no_of_tests;
 IF :usable_reagents.prep_flag = 'I' then
 :usable_reagents.reagent_status := 'R';
 END IF; 
exception
 when others then 
 handle_error;
end;

 from valid_reagents

 --

 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:USABLE_REAGENTS.EXPIRY_DATE,v_local_time);
 :USABLE_REAGENTS.EXPIRY_DATE := v_local_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- 
exception

 show_error('2316');
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 present_reg_id varchar2(10);
 temp_reg_id varchar2(10);
 present_kit_id varchar2(35);
 temp_kit_id varchar2(35);
 rec_no number(2);
begin
 nullchk;
 rec_no := :system.cursor_record;
 IF rec_no > 1 THEN --For Duplicate Reagent Code 
 present_reg_id := :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id;
 go_record(1);
 loop
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE'; 
 temp_reg_id := :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id;
 if temp_reg_id = present_reg_id then
 go_record(rec_no);
 show_error('2324');
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 END IF;
 IF :system.record_status = 'INSERT' THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT vr.reagent_code, chapter_id, 
 kit_lot_number, container_id,
 lot_number, expiry_date, 
 remaining_tests, control_ind,
 nvl(vr.master_lot_required,'N'), vr.reagent_name
 INTO :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_code, :usable_reagent_mix.chapter_id,
 :usable_reagent_mix.kit_lot_number, :usable_reagent_mix.container_id,
 :usable_reagent_mix.lot_number, :usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date,
 :usable_reagent_mix.remaining_tests, :usable_reagent_mix.control_ind,
 :usable_reagent_mix.master_lot_req, :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_name
 FROM reagent_store_mst rsm, valid_reagents vr 
 WHERE rsm.reagent_id = :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id 
 AND vr.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 AND vr.reagent_type in (:usable_reagents.reagent_type,'R')
 AND vr.test_id = rsm.test_id
 AND vr.reagent_code = rsm.reagent_code
 AND rsm.reagent_code != :usable_reagents.reagent_code
 AND vr.preparation_flag in ('Y','I') 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate)
 AND rsm.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 AND nvl(rsm.kit_lot_number,'XNULLX') = 
 decode(nvl(vr.master_lot_required,'N'),
 'Y',nvl(:GLOBAL.kit_lot,nvl(rsm.kit_lot_number,'XNULLX')), 
 nvl(rsm.kit_lot_number,'XNULLX'))
 AND nvl(rsm.remaining_tests,0) > 0 
 AND rsm.reject_reason_code is null 
 AND rsm.expiry_date >= sysdate
 AND nvl(:USABLE_REAGENTS.control_ind, '$$$$') 
 = nvl(rsm.control_ind,nvl(:usable_reagents.control_ind,'$$$$'))
 AND rsm.expiry_date >= :usable_reagents.expiry_date
 AND (rsm.lab_code = :global.user_testing_lab_code
 or :global.user_testing_lab_code = '99');
 IF :master_lot_req = 'Y' and :GLOBAL.kit_lot is null THEN
 :GLOBAL.kit_lot := :usable_reagent_mix.kit_lot_number;
 END IF;
 next_item;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('4019');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 END IF; 
end;

Item.Name: QUANTITY
Item.Hint: Enter Check Out Tests, use [CREREC] to move to the next line.

Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :usable_reagent_mix.quantity is null or :usable_reagent_mix.quantity <= 0 then
 show_error('2323');
 else

 (:usable_reagent_mix.remaining_tests+nvl(:prev_quant,0))

exception

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 INVENTORY_RECEIPT NUMBER(10);
 INHAND_INVENTORY NUMBER(10);
 PRESENT_CHK_OUT NUMBER(10);
 s_temp_kit_id varchar2(25);
 s_present_kit_id varchar2(25);
 rec_no number(2); 
begin
 begin
 if :usable_reagent_mix.prep_reagent_id is null then
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure; 
 go_record(1);
 loop
 if :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_code is null 
 then
 show_error('4018'); /*No reagents in stock is used for preparation*/
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :usable_reagent_mix.quantity IS NULL then
 show_error('2323');
 end if;
 IF :usable_reagents.reagent_type = 'C' 
 THEN
 DECLARE
 r_type varchar2(1);
 c_ind varchar2(10);
 BEGIN 
 SELECT reagent_type, control_ind
 INTO r_type, c_ind
 FROM reagent_store_mst 
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 AND reagent_id = :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id
 AND (lab_code = :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code or
 :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code = '99')
 AND reject_reason_code is null ; 
 IF r_type = 'C' and c_ind != :USABLE_REAGENTS.control_ind THEN
 show_error('9767');
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF; 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE' ;
 down;
 end loop;
 begin
 IF :usable_reagent_mix.master_lot_req = 'Y' THEN
 s_present_kit_id := :usable_reagent_mix.kit_lot_number;
 rec_no := :system.cursor_record; 
 go_record(1);
 loop
 IF :usable_reagent_mix.master_lot_req = 'Y' THEN 
 s_temp_kit_id := :usable_reagent_mix.kit_lot_number;
 if s_temp_kit_id != s_present_kit_id then
 go_record(rec_no);
 show_error('1833');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 go_record(rec_no);
 end if;
 end;
 end if;
 end;
 if :usable_reagents.reagent_type is null or :usable_reagents.reagent_code is null or
 :usable_reagents.min_storage_temp is null or :usable_reagents.max_storage_temp is null
 or :usable_reagents.no_of_tests is null or :usable_reagents.expiry_date is null or 
 :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_code is null or :usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date is null 
 or :usable_reagent_mix.quantity is null 
 then
 show_error('2311');
 end if; 
 UPDATE_QUANTITY;
exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('2319');
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

:usable_reagent_mix.reagent_name := :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_code;
:usable_reagent_mix.prep_reagent_id := :usable_reagents.reagent_id;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 exp_date date;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 -- 
 if :usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date,v_local_time);
 :usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date := v_local_time;
 end if;
 end if; 
 -- 
 :system.message_level := 0;
 IF :GLOBAL.exp_date is null THEN
 :GLOBAL.exp_date := to_char(:usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') ;
 ELSE
 exp_date := to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.exp_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 IF :usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date < exp_date THEN 
 :GLOBAL.exp_date := 
 to_char(:usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') ; 
 END IF;
 END IF;
 :prev_quant := :quantity;
 if :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id IS NOT NULL then
 
 -- to replace sysdate
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 v_local_time := null; 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 select rsm.reagent_code,reagent_name,
 master_lot_required, remaining_tests,
 rsm.kit_lot_number
 into :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_code,:usable_reagent_mix.reagent_name, 
 :usable_reagent_mix.master_lot_req, :usable_reagent_mix.remaining_tests,
 :usable_reagent_mix.kit_lot_number 
 from valid_reagents vr, reagent_store_mst rsm 
 where rsm.reagent_id = :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id
 and vr.reagent_code = rsm.reagent_code 
 and vr.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 and vr.test_id = rsm.test_id
 and v_local_time between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_local_time);
 --
 else -- timezone
 select rsm.reagent_code,reagent_name,
 master_lot_required, remaining_tests,
 rsm.kit_lot_number
 into :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_code,:usable_reagent_mix.reagent_name, 
 :usable_reagent_mix.master_lot_req, :usable_reagent_mix.remaining_tests,
 :usable_reagent_mix.kit_lot_number 
 from valid_reagents vr, reagent_store_mst rsm 
 where rsm.reagent_id = :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id
 and vr.reagent_code = rsm.reagent_code 
 and vr.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_id
 and vr.test_id = rsm.test_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate);
 end if; -- timezone 
 else
 null;
 end if;
exception when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('2316');
end;
IF :GLOBAL.kit_lot is null and :master_lot_req = 'Y' THEN
 :GLOBAL.kit_lot := :usable_reagent_mix.kit_lot_number;
END IF;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT') THEN
 set_item_property('usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id',navigable,property_true); 
 go_item('usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id');
ELSIF :ctrl_blk_1.s_reagent_id != 'NEW' and :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code = '99' 
THEN
 set_item_property('usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id',navigable,property_false); 
 go_item('usable_reagent_mix.quantity');
 synchronize;
END IF;

 up;
elsif :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED') THEN
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 up;
else 
 show_error('1701');
end if;

null;

Trigger.Name: KEY-CREREC

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_QUANTITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_quantity IS
 rem_tst number(10);
 ck_quan number(10) := 0;
 new_quan number(10);
 new_rem number(10);
 prev_quan number(10);
begin
 go_block('usable_reagent_mix'); 
 go_record(1); 
 while :system.last_record = 'FALSE' 
 loop
 if :quantity != 0 then
 exit;
 else
 down;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' and :quantity = 0 then
 :no_of_tests := 0;
 :usable_reagents.expiry_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 go_record(1);
 loop 
 IF :system.record_status in ('INSERT','CHANGED') THEN
 select remaining_tests
 into rem_tst 
 from reagent_store_mst
 where reagent_id = :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 BEGIN 
 select quantity
 into ck_quan 
 from usable_reagent_mix 
 where reagent_id = :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id
 and prep_reagent_id = :usable_reagent_mix.prep_reagent_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id ;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 ck_quan := 0;
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 END; 
 new_rem := rem_tst + ck_quan - :usable_reagent_mix.quantity;
 IF rem_tst < 0 THEN
 show_error('2325');
 END IF; 
 update reagent_store_mst 
 set remaining_tests = new_rem
 where reagent_id = :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; 
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE' ;
 END IF;
 down; 
 end loop;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 valid_kit varchar2(1) := 'N';
 v_gmt_time date;
begin
 if :usable_reagents.reagent_type is null or 
 :usable_reagents.reagent_code is null or
 :usable_reagents.min_storage_temp is null or 
 :usable_reagents.max_storage_temp is null or 
 :usable_reagents.no_of_tests is null or 
 :usable_reagents.expiry_date is null or 
 :usable_reagent_mix.reagent_code is null or 
 :usable_reagent_mix.expiry_date is null or 
 :usable_reagent_mix.quantity is null
 then
 show_error('2311');
 else
 go_block('usable_reagents');
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('usable_reagent_mix'); 
 IF :usable_reagents.m_lot_req = 'Y' THEN
 go_record(1);
 loop
 IF :usable_reagent_mix.master_lot_req = 'Y' THEN
 :usable_reagents.kit_lot_number := :usable_reagent_mix.kit_lot_number;
 exit;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 END IF;
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure; 
 :system.message_level := '5'; 
 --
 if :USABLE_REAGENTS.EXPIRY_DATE is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:USABLE_REAGENTS.EXPIRY_DATE,v_gmt_time);
 :USABLE_REAGENTS.EXPIRY_DATE := v_gmt_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- 
 --
 if :USABLE_REAGENT_MIX.EXPIRY_DATE is not null then
 v_gmt_time := null;
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,:USABLE_REAGENT_MIX.EXPIRY_DATE,v_gmt_time);
 :USABLE_REAGENT_MIX.EXPIRY_DATE := v_gmt_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 -- 
 commit;
 if form_success then
 bell;
 :system.message_level := '0'; 
 show_error('0000');
 check_package_failure;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 else
 :system.message_level := '0'; 
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('2318');
 end if; 
 end if;
exception 
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;
